## NASCAR Driver Toni Breidinger Teams Up with Kelley Blue Book to Test 2023 Best New Model Winner Hyundai IONIQ 5
**ATLANTA, December 15, 2022** – After thorough head-to-head testing, in-depth data analysis and evaluation of the more than 300 new-vehicle models available in the U.S. market for 2023, Kelley Blue Book, a Cox Automotive company, today announces the winners of its annual Best Buy Awards. Now in its ninth year, the company’s comprehensive awards program highlights the top model in vehicle segments most relevant to new-car shoppers, with award categories evolving over the years to align with the changing automotive landscape. The 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Awards encompass 19 categories covering the entire spectrum of automotive needs, with additional categories introduced this year to reflect the ever-growing electrified-vehicle segments. This year’s highest honor of Best New Model goes to the 2023 Hyundai IONIQ 5.
“The number of electric vehicles available to new-car shoppers continues to increase at a staggering pace, and the competition continues to get hotter as these efficient rides gain popularity among consumers,” said Jason Allan, principal editor of reviews and ratings for Kelley Blue Book. “Our team was so impressed with the all-new Hyundai IONIQ 5 during this year’s Best Buy Awards testing that we didn’t just give it the title of Best Electric Vehicle for 2023, it also earned our Best New Model trophy. It is truly a vehicle that exemplifies how easy it can be now to go all-electric, boasting the kind of impressive range and tech features that consumers have come to expect, and offering terrific value relative to the competition. In addition to the Best New Model, our team also named the top 2023 model-year vehicles in the categories most relevant to today’s car shoppers.”
This year, Kelley Blue Book partnered with NASCAR driver Toni Breidinger so she could use her professional racecar driver skills to put the top winner to the test out on the ‘track’ of real-world driving. Breidinger joined Kelley Blue Book’s editors for a day of test driving the Hyundai IONIQ 5, sharing her thoughts and driving impressions as she evaluated the all-new model through the lens of a racecar driver.

## NASCAR Driver Toni Breidinger Teams Up with Kelley Blue Book to Test 2023 Best New Model Winner Hyundai IONIQ 5
“As a lifelong automotive enthusiast, it was a thrill to join the experts from Kelley Blue Book for a day to put the 2023 Hyundai IONIQ 5 to the test,” said Toni Breidinger, NASCAR driver. “The spacious interior and extended dashboard really stood out to me. Most importantly, I appreciated the all-electric range. After a test day with the IONIQ 5, I can confirm this year’s Best New Model is racer-approved.”
Kelley Blue Book’s annual Best Buy Awards are determined based on a year-long regimen of expert vehicle evaluation, plus an intensive period of final testing. Our reviews, ratings and awards are driven by analysis of a broad array of vehicle-related data, including vehicle pricing, 5-Year Cost to Own data – which includes depreciation, insurance, maintenance, financing, fuel, fees and taxes for new cars – along with consumer reviews and ratings and vehicle sales information. To be considered for Kelley Blue Book’s highest accolade, Best New Model, the vehicle must be an all-new or redesigned vehicle – unavailable before the prior year’s final Best Buy Awards testing – and offer a strong value proposition to consumers based on pricing, innovation, and available standard technology and safety features.
**2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners**
**Best Compact Car: 2023 Honda Civic**
There’s a reason the 2023 Honda Civic tops our Best Compact Car list, a feat it has now accomplished eight of the last nine years: It just does everything right. The Civic sedan is a joy to drive. It’s a worry-free mode of transport that won’t break the budget, and the Civic holds its value exceptionally well.
**Best Subcompact SUV: 2023 Kia Seltos**
When you’re shopping for a subcompact SUV, every dollar counts. That’s why the Kia Seltos is our Best Subcompact SUV winner again for 2023. Its low starting price, long list of standard tech and safety features, impressive fuel economy and fantastic warranty make the Seltos a terrific value. This stylish SUV also boasts one of the roomiest interiors in its class.
**Best Compact SUV: 2023 Honda CR-V**

## NASCAR Driver Toni Breidinger Teams Up with Kelley Blue Book to Test 2023 Best New Model Winner Hyundai IONIQ 5
The Honda CR-V has been among the easiest vehicles to recommend for many, many years. In fact, it has been named a Kelley Blue Book Best Buy more times than any other compact SUV. Fresh off a complete redesign and now bigger and better than ever, the CR-V has reclaimed its place as the compact SUV we deem to be the best choice for the most people.
**Best 2-Row Midsize SUV: 2023 Hyundai Santa Fe**
We recognize not only the immense value of this 5-passenger SUV but also its wide appeal. Hyundai hangs its collective hat on its value story, and nowhere is that value more apparent than in the level and quality of its technology. To find an SUV at this price point with this degree of attention to detail inside and out is a tribute to Hyundai’s genius for making every dollar count.
**Best 3-Row Midsize SUV: 2023 Kia Telluride**
For 2023, the Telluride wins this category for the fourth time, winning every year since it went on sale. The Telluride is great-looking and roomy with an upscale interior. It’s practical with a stacked roster of standard safety and convenience equipment. The Telluride is an excellent value in the midsize SUV segment.
**Best Full-Size SUV: 2023 Ford Expedition**
The 2023 Ford Expedition is a comfortable, refined 8-passenger full-size SUV that is ready for work and travel. It can tow up to 9,300 pounds, while features like Pro Trailer Backup Assist 2.0 and a blind-spot system that also accounts for the trailer make towing easier.
**Best Compact Pickup Truck: 2023 Ford Maverick**
The Ford Maverick heralds the return of the compact pickup, providing light-duty versatility in a truck as easy on gas as it is on the eyes. With nearly 500 miles of range, the hybrid Maverick bests even the most frugal subcompact, yet it’s capable of hauling a 1,500-pound payload and towing up to 2,000 pounds – or 4,000 pounds with the all-gas powertrain.

## NASCAR Driver Toni Breidinger Teams Up with Kelley Blue Book to Test 2023 Best New Model Winner Hyundai IONIQ 5
**Best Midsize Pickup Truck: 2023 Toyota Tacoma**
Where midsize pickup trucks are concerned, the 2023 Toyota Tacoma cannot be beaten. No matter the metric you use, the Tacoma tops its class. This begins in the showroom where you will find exactly the cab style, trim level, cargo-box length, engine and drivetrain to suit your needs. Thanks to the Tacoma’s Toyota-tough reliability, you won’t be on a first-name basis with the local dealership’s service writer. Moreover, when you’re finally ready to trade in or sell your Tacoma, you’ll appreciate its uncanny ability to retain its value over the years.
**Best Full-Size Pickup Truck: 2023 Ford F-150**
Whether it’s a basic work truck, an opulent people mover, or something in between, Ford offers an F-150 to do the job. On a mission to put its own stamp on future mobility, Ford loads up the 2023 Ford F-150 with technology, while electrifying the lineup with a hybrid and fully electric model. The F-150 excels when towing and hauling, and Ford continues to exceed buyers’ expectations.
**Best Electric Truck: 2023 Ford F-150 Lightning**
The Ford F-150 Lightning, the all-electric version of the perennially best-selling Ford F-Series, is a great buy for its reasonable pricing, impressive range and advanced tech features. As for its capabilities, the F-150 Lightning has some impressive specs for an EV. It can tow up to 10,000 pounds and it has a maximum payload rating of 2,000 pounds.
**Best Minivan: 2023 Toyota Sienna**
The Toyota Sienna is our Best Buy in the Minivan segment for the third consecutive year. Its “threepeat” is well deserved for offering just about everything you could want in a family hauler. The Sienna’s interior is an excellent execution of the “living room on wheels” characteristic that families love, and the hybrid powertrain gives it low fuel costs. The Sienna also is an outstanding value when it comes to what minivan drivers really value - safety and reliability.

## NASCAR Driver Toni Breidinger Teams Up with Kelley Blue Book to Test 2023 Best New Model Winner Hyundai IONIQ 5
**Best EV Under $35,000: 2023 Chevrolet Bolt EUV**
As a slightly longer version of the Bolt EV, the Bolt EUV (Electric Utility Vehicle) impressed the KBB.com editors with its roomy back seat and excellent build quality, along with its great price and impressive 247-mile range. With EVs in general, but especially those on the affordable end of the spectrum, car shoppers tend to measure their value in a simple fashion - by how far they can go on a full charge and at what price. It is a fair, real-world approach. By this measurement, the 2023 Chevrolet Bolt EUV shines brightly.
**Best Plug-in Hybrid Vehicle: 2023 Kia Sportage Plug-in Hybrid**
The best of both worlds, the Kia Sportage Plug-in Hybrid is both the most powerful and the most fuel-efficient model in the all-new Sportage lineup. With 34 miles of all-electric range followed by hybrid fuel economy of 35 mpg, you can enjoy driving in comfort while only occasionally having to stop for gas.
**Best Luxury Car: 2023 Lexus ES**
The Lexus ES checks all the boxes for a luxury vehicle – and then some – yet does so in an unpretentious way. On the road its manners are without fault, yet the success story of the ES goes far beyond it being a rewarding car to drive. Its narrative includes plot lines not usually associated with luxury cars, including a stellar value proposition and rock-solid reliability.
**Best Subcompact Luxury SUV: 2023 BMW X1**
All-new for 2023 with bolder looks, better technology and a grown-up persona, the BMW X1 also is now a first-time member of the Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award club. The BMW X1 has long been a gateway into the German luxury brand, representing BMW’s smallest SUV and one of its best values. Now is the X1’s time to shine.
**Best Compact Luxury SUV: 2023 Genesis GV70**
It is no mystery why GV70 continues to win accolades. Its enticing good looks and feature-rich equipment offerings are alluring, but the GV70’s value story turns just as many heads.

## NASCAR Driver Toni Breidinger Teams Up with Kelley Blue Book to Test 2023 Best New Model Winner Hyundai IONIQ 5
**Best Midsize Luxury SUV: 2023 Genesis GV80**
The Genesis GV80 is the brand’s first SUV and a relative newcomer to the midsize luxury SUV segment, yet it already has established itself as a leader in this competitive class. It has a roomy, luxurious interior with available 3-row seating, an engaging drive with two engine options, excellent safety ratings and a class-leading warranty.
For more information and full coverage of the 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Awards, including full editorial comments about each model, pricing details, videos and more, visit https://www.kbb.com/awards/best-buy-awards-2023/.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## Kelley Blue Book’s ‘Best Compact SUVs of 2023’
Each year, Kelley Blue Book editors examine each entry in the compact SUV segment. They look at every model’s exterior design, interior styling, performance, reliability, safety features, and overall value.In addition, they take into account reviews from other industry experts and consumers. But most important, the editors test-drive and live with every vehicle for “performance, features, cargo space, technology, build, fuel economy, and more.”
KBB’s yearly list of the best compact SUVs includes models from various automakers, including mainstream brands like Ford, Honda, and Toyota. It might also contain SUVs from luxury brands like Audi, BMW, and Mercedes-Benz. Each vehicle on the list gets a thorough overview, including key features, price ranges, and specifications, to help consumers make informed decisions.
And this year, the only luxury SUV to make the list is the 2023 Audi Q5, ranking third out of 11 vehicles. Topping the rankings in first and second place are the 2023 Honda CR-V and CR-V Hybrid. The 2023 Kia Sportage takes fourth, fifth, and seventh place with the standard model, Sportage Hybrid, and Sportage Plug-In Hybrid. The 2023 Toyota RAV4 sits in sixth, seventh, and ninth with the standard model, RAV4 Hybrid, and RAV4 Prime plug-in hybrid. And rounding out the list in 10th and 11th place are two Mazda compact SUVs: the CX-5 and the CX-50.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## The 2023 Audi Q5 is the only luxury SUV in KBB’s ‘Best Compact SUVs’ this year
2023 Audi Q5 Prestige | Audi AG
The 2023 Audi Q5 compact luxury SUV seats five and is available in three trim levels, each offering various configurations. All have a seven-speed automatic transmission. The standard engine is a 201-hp 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder. Quicker acceleration is available with a more powerful 261-hp four-cylinder or a 362-hp plug-in hybrid. When properly equipped, the Q5 has a maximum towing capacity of 4,400 pounds.
The new Audi Q5 is loaded with infotainment features, such as Bang & Olufsen premium speakers, Android Auto, and wireless Apple CarPlay. It has all the convenience and comfort features you’d expect from a luxury SUV and includes a full slate of advanced safety features. It offers a blind-spot and lane departure warnings accident avoidance system, lane-keep assist, rear cross-traffic alert, adaptive cruise control, and more.
2023 Audi Q5 prices range from about $44,200 to $67,00, according to Audi.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## Kelley Blue Book’s verdict
2023 Audi Q5 interior | Audi AG
KBB editors loved the 2023 Audi Q5’sVirtual Cockpit Plus, a standard digital gauge cluster on the Premium Plus and Prestige trims. The customizable display can show entertainment info, navigation intel, road signs, and more. They also liked the user-friendliness of its high-tech standard infotainment system, with a stunning 10.1-inch display and many popular features, including HD Radio and a Wi-Fi hotspot.
KBB also appreciated the diverse selection of engines in the new Audi Q5. They liked that the Quattro all-wheel drive system is standard on every model. It improves traction in any weather condition for a more confident, powerful drive.
In addition to the standard Q5 SUV body style, buyers can opt for the Sportback, which KBB found to be stylish with the aesthetic of an “SUV coupe.” While there’s more cargo space in the standard body, the Sportback is an attention-getter with great visual appeal. Still, KBB believes the 2023 Audi Q5 in either body style would benefit from additional cargo space.
The high-performance model SQ5, with its turbocharged V6, offers a thrilling driving experience. It also features upgraded brakes with adaptive damping suspension. It’s expensive, so if you likehowy it looks, you might also consider the S Line model, according to KBB.
The only other criticism Kelley Blue Book editors had was that some of the 2023 Audi Q5’s peers are more affordable.

It’s a worry-free mode of transport that won’t break the budget, and the Civic holds its value exceptionally well.
**Best Subcompact SUV: 2023 Kia Seltos**
When you’re shopping for a subcompact SUV, every dollar counts. That’s why the Kia Seltos is our Best Subcompact SUV winner again for 2023. Its low starting price, long list of standard tech and safety features, impressive fuel economy and fantastic warranty make the Seltos a terrific value. This stylish SUV also boasts one of the roomiest interiors in its class.
**Best Compact SUV: 2023 Honda CR-V**

## NASCAR Driver Toni Breidinger Teams Up with Kelley Blue Book to Test 2023 Best New Model Winner Hyundai IONIQ 5
The Honda CR-V has been among the easiest vehicles to recommend for many, many years. In fact, it has been named a Kelley Blue Book Best Buy more times than any other compact SUV. Fresh off a complete redesign and now bigger and better than ever, the CR-V has reclaimed its place as the compact SUV we deem to be the best choice for the most people.
**Best 2-Row Midsize SUV: 2023 Hyundai Santa Fe**
We recognize not only the immense value of this 5-passenger SUV but also its wide appeal. Hyundai hangs its collective hat on its value story, and nowhere is that value more apparent than in the level and quality of its technology. To find an SUV at this price point with this degree of attention to detail inside and out is a tribute to Hyundai’s genius for making every dollar count.
**Best 3-Row Midsize SUV: 2023 Kia Telluride**
For 2023, the Telluride wins this category for the fourth time, winning every year since it went on sale. The Telluride is great-looking and roomy with an upscale interior. It’s practical with a stacked roster of standard safety and convenience equipment. The Telluride is an excellent value in the midsize SUV segment.
**Best Full-Size SUV: 2023 Ford Expedition**
The 2023 Ford Expedition is a comfortable, refined 8-passenger full-size SUV that is ready for work and travel. It can tow up to 9,300 pounds, while features like Pro Trailer Backup Assist 2.0 and a blind-spot system that also accounts for the trailer make towing easier.
**Best Compact Pickup Truck: 2023 Ford Maverick**
The Ford Maverick heralds the return of the compact pickup, providing light-duty versatility in a truck as easy on gas as it is on the eyes. With nearly 500 miles of range, the hybrid Maverick bests even the most frugal subcompact, yet it’s capable of hauling a 1,500-pound payload and towing up to 2,000 pounds – or 4,000 pounds with the all-gas powertrain.

The F-150 excels when towing and hauling, and Ford continues to exceed buyers’ expectations.
**Best Electric Truck: 2023 Ford F-150 Lightning**
The Ford F-150 Lightning, the all-electric version of the perennially best-selling Ford F-Series, is a great buy for its reasonable pricing, impressive range and advanced tech features. **Best Minivan: 2023 Toyota Sienna**
The Toyota Sienna is our Best Buy in the Minivan segment for the third consecutive year. Its “threepeat” is well deserved for offering just about everything you could want in a family hauler. The Sienna’s interior is an excellent execution of the “living room on wheels” characteristic that families love, and the hybrid powertrain gives it low fuel costs. The Sienna also is an outstanding value when it comes to what minivan drivers really value - safety and reliability.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## Kelley Blue Book’s ‘Best Compact SUVs of 2023’
Each year, Kelley Blue Book editors examine each entry in the compact SUV segment. They look at every model’s exterior design, interior styling, performance, reliability, safety features, and overall value.In addition, they take into account reviews from other industry experts and consumers. But most important, the editors test-drive and live with every vehicle for “performance, features, cargo space, technology, build, fuel economy, and more.”
KBB’s yearly list of the best compact SUVs includes models from various automakers, including mainstream brands like Ford, Honda, and Toyota. It might also contain SUVs from luxury brands like Audi, BMW, and Mercedes-Benz. Each vehicle on the list gets a thorough overview, including key features, price ranges, and specifications, to help consumers make informed decisions.
And this year, the only luxury SUV to make the list is the 2023 Audi Q5, ranking third out of 11 vehicles. Topping the rankings in first and second place are the 2023 Honda CR-V and CR-V Hybrid. The 2023 Kia Sportage takes fourth, fifth, and seventh place with the standard model, Sportage Hybrid, and Sportage Plug-In Hybrid. The 2023 Toyota RAV4 sits in sixth, seventh, and ninth with the standard model, RAV4 Hybrid, and RAV4 Prime plug-in hybrid. And rounding out the list in 10th and 11th place are two Mazda compact SUVs: the CX-5 and the CX-50.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## The 2023 Audi Q5 is the only luxury SUV in KBB’s ‘Best Compact SUVs’ this year
2023 Audi Q5 Prestige | Audi AG
The 2023 Audi Q5 compact luxury SUV seats five and is available in three trim levels, each offering various configurations. All have a seven-speed automatic transmission. The standard engine is a 201-hp 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder. Quicker acceleration is available with a more powerful 261-hp four-cylinder or a 362-hp plug-in hybrid. When properly equipped, the Q5 has a maximum towing capacity of 4,400 pounds.
The new Audi Q5 is loaded with infotainment features, such as Bang & Olufsen premium speakers, Android Auto, and wireless Apple CarPlay. It has all the convenience and comfort features you’d expect from a luxury SUV and includes a full slate of advanced safety features. It offers a blind-spot and lane departure warnings accident avoidance system, lane-keep assist, rear cross-traffic alert, adaptive cruise control, and more.
2023 Audi Q5 prices range from about $44,200 to $67,00, according to Audi.
texts.4:
# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## Kelley Blue Book’s verdict
2023 Audi Q5 interior | Audi AG
KBB editors loved the 2023 Audi Q5’sVirtual Cockpit Plus, a standard digital gauge cluster on the Premium Plus and Prestige trims. The customizable display can show entertainment info, navigation intel, road signs, and more. They also liked the user-friendliness of its high-tech standard infotainment system, with a stunning 10.1-inch display and many popular features, including HD Radio and a Wi-Fi hotspot.
KBB also appreciated the diverse selection of engines in the new Audi Q5. They liked that the Quattro all-wheel drive system is standard on every model. It improves traction in any weather condition for a more confident, powerful drive.
In addition to the standard Q5 SUV body style, buyers can opt for the Sportback, which KBB found to be stylish with the aesthetic of an “SUV coupe.” While there’s more cargo space in the standard body, the Sportback is an attention-getter with great visual appeal. Still, KBB believes the 2023 Audi Q5 in either body style would benefit from additional cargo space.
The high-performance model SQ5, with its turbocharged V6, offers a thrilling driving experience. It also features upgraded brakes with adaptive damping suspension. It’s expensive, so if you likehowy it looks, you might also consider the S Line model, according to KBB.
The only other criticism Kelley Blue Book editors had was that some of the 2023 Audi Q5’s peers are more affordable.

**Best Electric Truck: 2023 Ford F-150 Lightning**
The Ford F-150 Lightning, the all-electric version of the perennially best-selling Ford F-Series, is a great buy for its reasonable pricing, impressive range and advanced tech features. **Best Minivan: 2023 Toyota Sienna**
The Toyota Sienna is our Best Buy in the Minivan segment for the third consecutive year. Its “threepeat” is well deserved for offering just about everything you could want in a family hauler. The Sienna’s interior is an excellent execution of the “living room on wheels” characteristic that families love, and the hybrid powertrain gives it low fuel costs. The Sienna also is an outstanding value when it comes to what minivan drivers really value - safety and reliability.

**Best EV Under $35,000: 2023 Chevrolet Bolt EUV**
As a slightly longer version of the Bolt EV, the Bolt EUV (Electric Utility Vehicle) impressed the KBB.com editors with its roomy back seat and excellent build quality, along with its great price and impressive 247-mile range. With EVs in general, but especially those on the affordable end of the spectrum, car shoppers tend to measure their value in a simple fashion - by how far they can go on a full charge and at what price. **Best Luxury Car: 2023 Lexus ES**
The Lexus ES checks all the boxes for a luxury vehicle – and then some – yet does so in an unpretentious way. On the road its manners are without fault, yet the success story of the ES goes far beyond it being a rewarding car to drive. Its narrative includes plot lines not usually associated with luxury cars, including a stellar value proposition and rock-solid reliability.
**Best Subcompact Luxury SUV: 2023 BMW X1**
All-new for 2023 with bolder looks, better technology and a grown-up persona, the BMW X1 also is now a first-time member of the Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award club. The BMW X1 has long been a gateway into the German luxury brand, representing BMW’s smallest SUV and one of its best values. Now is the X1’s time to shine.
**Best Compact Luxury SUV: 2023 Genesis GV70**
It is no mystery why GV70 continues to win accolades. Its enticing good looks and feature-rich equipment offerings are alluring, but the GV70’s value story turns just as many heads.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## Kelley Blue Book’s ‘Best Compact SUVs of 2023’
Each year, Kelley Blue Book editors examine each entry in the compact SUV segment. They look at every model’s exterior design, interior styling, performance, reliability, safety features, and overall value.In addition, they take into account reviews from other industry experts and consumers. But most important, the editors test-drive and live with every vehicle for “performance, features, cargo space, technology, build, fuel economy, and more.”
KBB’s yearly list of the best compact SUVs includes models from various automakers, including mainstream brands like Ford, Honda, and Toyota. It might also contain SUVs from luxury brands like Audi, BMW, and Mercedes-Benz. Each vehicle on the list gets a thorough overview, including key features, price ranges, and specifications, to help consumers make informed decisions.
And this year, the only luxury SUV to make the list is the 2023 Audi Q5, ranking third out of 11 vehicles. Topping the rankings in first and second place are the 2023 Honda CR-V and CR-V Hybrid. The 2023 Kia Sportage takes fourth, fifth, and seventh place with the standard model, Sportage Hybrid, and Sportage Plug-In Hybrid. The 2023 Toyota RAV4 sits in sixth, seventh, and ninth with the standard model, RAV4 Hybrid, and RAV4 Prime plug-in hybrid. And rounding out the list in 10th and 11th place are two Mazda compact SUVs: the CX-5 and the CX-50.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## The 2023 Audi Q5 is the only luxury SUV in KBB’s ‘Best Compact SUVs’ this year
2023 Audi Q5 Prestige | Audi AG
The 2023 Audi Q5 compact luxury SUV seats five and is available in three trim levels, each offering various configurations. All have a seven-speed automatic transmission. The standard engine is a 201-hp 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder. Quicker acceleration is available with a more powerful 261-hp four-cylinder or a 362-hp plug-in hybrid. When properly equipped, the Q5 has a maximum towing capacity of 4,400 pounds.
The new Audi Q5 is loaded with infotainment features, such as Bang & Olufsen premium speakers, Android Auto, and wireless Apple CarPlay. It has all the convenience and comfort features you’d expect from a luxury SUV and includes a full slate of advanced safety features. It offers a blind-spot and lane departure warnings accident avoidance system, lane-keep assist, rear cross-traffic alert, adaptive cruise control, and more.
2023 Audi Q5 prices range from about $44,200 to $67,00, according to Audi.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## Kelley Blue Book’s verdict
2023 Audi Q5 interior | Audi AG
KBB editors loved the 2023 Audi Q5’sVirtual Cockpit Plus, a standard digital gauge cluster on the Premium Plus and Prestige trims. The customizable display can show entertainment info, navigation intel, road signs, and more. They also liked the user-friendliness of its high-tech standard infotainment system, with a stunning 10.1-inch display and many popular features, including HD Radio and a Wi-Fi hotspot.
KBB also appreciated the diverse selection of engines in the new Audi Q5. They liked that the Quattro all-wheel drive system is standard on every model. It improves traction in any weather condition for a more confident, powerful drive.
In addition to the standard Q5 SUV body style, buyers can opt for the Sportback, which KBB found to be stylish with the aesthetic of an “SUV coupe.” While there’s more cargo space in the standard body, the Sportback is an attention-getter with great visual appeal. Still, KBB believes the 2023 Audi Q5 in either body style would benefit from additional cargo space.
The high-performance model SQ5, with its turbocharged V6, offers a thrilling driving experience. It also features upgraded brakes with adaptive damping suspension. It’s expensive, so if you likehowy it looks, you might also consider the S Line model, according to KBB.
The only other criticism Kelley Blue Book editors had was that some of the 2023 Audi Q5’s peers are more affordable.

These SUVs may be small overall, but they're spacious where it matters.
Like Mary Poppins' bag, some small SUVs hold more inside than one would reasonably expect based on their exterior proportions. The efficient use of space almost feels like magic.
Space-saving designs are particularly important for compact SUVs, which are wildly popular among Americans. Many drivers want an SUV small and light enough to maneuver crowded streets and sip fuel but large enough inside to comfortably carry their passengers and haul whatever items they happen to have. This list focuses on the latter desire.

The Infiniti QX50 is focused on comfort over performance, and even then, it doesn't exactly deliver. Ride quality is mostly comfortable, unless you're driving over particularly bumpy pavement. This SUV also has attractive interior styling and, as a requisite to being on this list, commendable cargo capacity.
The QX50 misses a mark in a lot of areas, though. Its turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine should theoretically deliver exciting acceleration, but its continuously variable automatic transmission holds it back. The setup is also noticeably noisy under fairly reasonable strain.

## Key takeaways
*   2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners  
    *   Best Electric Vehicle and Best New Model: 2023 Hyundai IONIQ 5  
    *   Best Compact Car: 2023 Honda Civic  
    *   Best Subcompact SUV: 2023 Kia Seltos  
    *   Best Compact SUV: 2023 Honda CR-V  
    *   Best 2-Row Midsize SUV: 2023 Hyundai Santa Fe  
    *   Best 3-Row Midsize SUV: 2023 Kia Telluride

    *   Best Compact Pickup Truck: 2023 Ford Maverick  
    *   Best Midsize Pickup Truck: 2023 Toyota Tacoma  
    *   Best Full-Size Pickup Truck: 2023 Ford F-150  
    *   Best Electric Truck: 2023 Ford F-150 Lightning  
    *   Best Minivan: 2023 Toyota Sienna  
    *   Best EV Under $35,000: 2023 Chevrolet Bolt EUV  
    *   Best Plug-in Hybrid Vehicle: 2023 Kia Sportage Plug-in Hybrid  
    *   Best Luxury Car: 2023 Lexus ES  
    *   Best Subcompact Luxury SUV: 2023 BMW X1  
    *   Best Compact Luxury SUV: 2023 Genesis GV70  
    *   Best Midsize Luxury SUV: 2023 Genesis GV80
After thorough head-to-head testing, in-depth data analysis and evaluation of the more than 300 new-vehicle models available in the U.S. market for 2023, _Kelley Blue Book_, a _Cox Automotive_ company, on Dec. 15 announced the winners of its annual Best Buy Awards.
Now in its ninth year, the company's comprehensive awards program highlights the top model in vehicle segments most relevant to new-car shoppers, with award categories evolving over the years to align with the changing automotive landscape.

## Key takeaways
The 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Awards encompass 19 categories covering the entire spectrum of automotive needs, with additional categories introduced this year to reflect the ever-growing electrified-vehicle segments.
This year's highest honor of Best New Model goes to the 2023 _Hyundai_ IONIQ 5.
"The number of electric vehicles available to new-car shoppers continues to increase at a staggering pace, and the competition continues to get hotter as these efficient rides gain popularity among consumers," said **Jason Allan**, principal editor of reviews and ratings for Kelley Blue Book. "Our team was so impressed with the all-new Hyundai IONIQ 5 during this year's Best Buy Awards testing that we didn't just give it the title of Best Electric Vehicle for 2023, it also earned our Best New Model trophy.
"It is truly a vehicle that exemplifies how easy it can be now to go all-electric, boasting the kind of impressive range and tech features that consumers have come to expect, and offering terrific value relative to the competition," Allan said. "In addition to the Best New Model, our team also named the top 2023 model-year vehicles in the categories most relevant to today's car shoppers."
This year, Kelley Blue Book partnered with NASCAR driver **Toni Breidinger** so she could use her professional racecar driver skills to put the top winner to the test out on the "track" of real-world driving. Breidinger joined Kelley Blue Book's editors for a day of test driving the Hyundai IONIQ 5, sharing her thoughts and driving impressions as she evaluated the all-new model through the lens of a racecar driver.
"As a lifelong automotive enthusiast, it was a thrill to join the experts from Kelley Blue Book for a day to put the 2023 Hyundai IONIQ 5 to the test," said Breidinger. "The spacious interior and extended dashboard really stood out to me. Most importantly, I appreciated the all-electric range. After a test day with the IONIQ 5, I can confirm this year's Best New Model is racer-approved."

## Key takeaways
Kelley Blue Book's annual Best Buy Awards are determined based on a year-long regimen of expert vehicle evaluation, plus an intensive period of final testing. The reviews, ratings and awards are driven by analysis of a broad array of vehicle-related data, including vehicle pricing, 5-Year Cost to Own data---which includes depreciation, insurance, maintenance, financing, fuel, fees and taxes for new cars---along with consumer reviews and ratings and vehicle sales information.
To be considered for Kelley Blue Book's highest accolade, Best New Model, the vehicle must be an all-new or redesigned vehicle---unavailable before the prior year's final Best Buy Awards testing---and offer a strong value proposition to consumers based on pricing, innovation and available standard technology and safety features.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best Electric Vehicle and Best New Model: 2023 Hyundai IONIQ 5
With more than 300 miles of range, a spacious, tech-filled interior and an impressive starting price, the Hyundai IONIQ 5 shows how easy it can be for someone to go all electric. You can even go from 10% charge to 80% in as little as 18 minutes.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best Compact Car: 2023 Honda Civic
There's a reason the 2023 _Honda_ Civic tops the Best Compact Car list, a feat it has now accomplished eight of the last nine years: It just does everything right. The Civic sedan is a joy to drive. It's a worry-free mode of transport that won't break the budget, and the Civic holds its value exceptionally well.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best Subcompact SUV: 2023 Kia Seltos
When shopping for a subcompact SUV, every dollar counts. That's why the _Kia_ Seltos is the Best Subcompact SUV winner again for 2023. Its low starting price, long list of standard tech and safety features, impressive fuel economy and fantastic warranty make the Seltos a terrific value. This stylish SUV also boasts one of the roomiest interiors in its class.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best Compact SUV: 2023 Honda CR-V
The Honda CR-V has been among the easiest vehicles to recommend for many, many years. In fact, it has been named a Kelley Blue Book Best Buy more times than any other compact SUV. Fresh off a complete redesign and now bigger and better than ever, the CR-V has reclaimed its place as the compact SUV deemed to be the best choice for the most people.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best 2-Row Midsize SUV: 2023 Hyundai Santa Fe
Kelley Blue Book recognizes not only the immense value of this five-passenger SUV but also its wide appeal. Hyundai hangs its collective hat on its value story, and nowhere is that value more apparent than in the level and quality of its technology. To find an SUV at this price point with this degree of attention to detail inside and out is a tribute to Hyundai's genius for making every dollar count.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best 3-Row Midsize SUV: 2023 Kia Telluride
For 2023, the Telluride wins this category for the fourth time, winning every year since it went on sale. The Telluride is great-looking and roomy with an upscale interior. It's practical with a stacked roster of standard safety and convenience equipment. The Telluride is an excellent value in the midsize SUV segment.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best Full-Size SUV: 2023 Ford Expedition
The 2023 _Ford_ Expedition is a comfortable, refined eight-passenger full-size SUV that is ready for work and travel. It can tow up to 9,300 pounds, while features like Pro Trailer Backup Assist 2.0 and a blind-spot system that also accounts for the trailer make towing easier.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best Compact Pickup Truck: 2023 Ford Maverick
The Ford Maverick heralds the return of the compact pickup, providing light-duty versatility in a truck as easy on gas as it is on the eyes. With nearly 500 miles of range, the hybrid Maverick bests even the most frugal subcompact, yet it's capable of hauling a 1,500-pound payload and towing up to 2,000 pounds---or 4,000 pounds with the all-gas powertrain.

# 1 Compact SUV Is Kelley Blue Book’s Best Buy of 2023
## KBB’s compact SUV best buy of 2023
2023 Honda CR-V | American Honda Motor Co., Inc
According to Kelley Blue Book, the compact SUV best buy of 2023 is the 2023 Honda CR-V. The publication says it’s one of the easiest models to recommend. Additionally, it’s won this specific award from KBB more times than any other model in its class. For 2023, it received a complete redesign, which helped it reestablish itself as one of the best overall compact SUVs. The sixth-generation Honda is bigger and better than ever, which is part of why KBB considers it the best choice for most buyers.
Not only is it an excellent choice for buying a new compact SUV, but KBB says it’s an even better option used. “Having developed a decades-deep reputation for reliability, the Honda CR-V is an especially attractive used vehicle. That means three years from now, a used 2023 Honda CR-V is likely to fetch as much as a few thousand dollars more than some of its competitors,” KBB said.

# 1 Compact SUV Is Kelley Blue Book’s Best Buy of 2023
## High-quality, functional interior
2023 Honda CR-V | Honda
The first reason the 2023 Honda CR-V is KBB’s compact SUV best buy of 2023 is its interior. Moreover, it has more cargo room inside than any of its competitors. The CR-V is easily compared to a small minivan by folding down the rear seatbacks. Its class-leading cargo volume is 76.5 cubic feet, and has a low cargo floor. Storing anything inside is seamless, even with passengers on board.
Next, there is also plenty of room in the front for people to ride comfortably. The latest CR-V has comfortable seats, excellent control placements, cup holders, and extra storage containers. In the rear, its seats offer an impressive 41 inches of legroom.
As for the design, it’s the perfect blend of conventional and upscale. There are plenty of modern screens like you’d expect, but the automaker kept physical knobs and buttons available. We still find it much easier to control volume, climate, and other common functions without going through touchscreen menus while driving.

# 1 Compact SUV Is Kelley Blue Book’s Best Buy of 2023
## 2023 Honda CR-V does many things better than rivals
It’s no secret that the 2023 Honda CR-V has a long history of excellent reliability and resale value. However, it also excels in many other areas. This isn’t just the used compact SUV you buy used a few years later. As a new model, it’s one of the best for having an accommodating interior, a stylish exterior, an efficient powertrain, and an overall fantastic driving experience.
Per KBB: “The new CR-V lives up to Honda’s hallmark of engineering vehicles that are exceptionally satisfying to drive. From the feel of the transmission selector to the intuitive response of the steering, braking, and acceleration inputs, driving a CR-V is as natural as having a conversation with your best friend.”
Additionally, the CR-V offers a wide selection of driver assistance and safety technology. According to Edmunds, that includes blind-spot warning with rear cross-traffic alert, forward collision mitigation, lane-keeping assistance, and adaptive cruise control. All are standard with the EX base model and outstanding amenities like heated front seats, dual-zone climate control, and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto.

# 1 Compact SUV Is Kelley Blue Book’s Best Buy of 2023
## The KBB best buy of compact SUVs is the Honda CR-V
In conclusion, the best buy of 2023 for the compact SUV segment from KBB is the 2023 Honda CR-V. To no one’s surprise, the CR-V continues to rack up awards year after year. With excellent value, safety, reliability, resale value, and a new redesign, it’s no surprise the 2023 model won again. Buyers and critics love the Honda model for its stylish exterior, comfortable and spacious interior, and reputation for reliability.

These SUVs may be small overall, but they're spacious where it matters.
Like Mary Poppins' bag, some small SUVs hold more inside than one would reasonably expect based on their exterior proportions. The efficient use of space almost feels like magic.
Space-saving designs are particularly important for compact SUVs, which are wildly popular among Americans. Many drivers want an SUV small and light enough to maneuver crowded streets and sip fuel but large enough inside to comfortably carry their passengers and haul whatever items they happen to have. This list focuses on the latter desire.

After thorough head-to-head testing, in-depth data analysis and evaluation of the more than 300 new-vehicle models available in the U.S. market for 2023, _Kelley Blue Book_, a _Cox Automotive_ company, on Dec. 15 announced the winners of its annual Best Buy Awards.

## Key takeaways
The 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Awards encompass 19 categories covering the entire spectrum of automotive needs, with additional categories introduced this year to reflect the ever-growing electrified-vehicle segments.
This year's highest honor of Best New Model goes to the 2023 _Hyundai_ IONIQ 5.
"The number of electric vehicles available to new-car shoppers continues to increase at a staggering pace, and the competition continues to get hotter as these efficient rides gain popularity among consumers," said **Jason Allan**, principal editor of reviews and ratings for Kelley Blue Book. "Our team was so impressed with the all-new Hyundai IONIQ 5 during this year's Best Buy Awards testing that we didn't just give it the title of Best Electric Vehicle for 2023, it also earned our Best New Model trophy.
"It is truly a vehicle that exemplifies how easy it can be now to go all-electric, boasting the kind of impressive range and tech features that consumers have come to expect, and offering terrific value relative to the competition," Allan said. "In addition to the Best New Model, our team also named the top 2023 model-year vehicles in the categories most relevant to today's car shoppers."
This year, Kelley Blue Book partnered with NASCAR driver **Toni Breidinger** so she could use her professional racecar driver skills to put the top winner to the test out on the "track" of real-world driving. Breidinger joined Kelley Blue Book's editors for a day of test driving the Hyundai IONIQ 5, sharing her thoughts and driving impressions as she evaluated the all-new model through the lens of a racecar driver.
"As a lifelong automotive enthusiast, it was a thrill to join the experts from Kelley Blue Book for a day to put the 2023 Hyundai IONIQ 5 to the test," said Breidinger. "The spacious interior and extended dashboard really stood out to me. Most importantly, I appreciated the all-electric range. After a test day with the IONIQ 5, I can confirm this year's Best New Model is racer-approved."
texts.3:
## Key takeaways
Kelley Blue Book's annual Best Buy Awards are determined based on a year-long regimen of expert vehicle evaluation, plus an intensive period of final testing. The reviews, ratings and awards are driven by analysis of a broad array of vehicle-related data, including vehicle pricing, 5-Year Cost to Own data---which includes depreciation, insurance, maintenance, financing, fuel, fees and taxes for new cars---along with consumer reviews and ratings and vehicle sales information.
To be considered for Kelley Blue Book's highest accolade, Best New Model, the vehicle must be an all-new or redesigned vehicle---unavailable before the prior year's final Best Buy Awards testing---and offer a strong value proposition to consumers based on pricing, innovation and available standard technology and safety features.

*   2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners

    *   Best Compact Car: 2023 Honda Civic

After thorough head-to-head testing, in-depth data analysis and evaluation of the more than 300 new-vehicle models available in the U.S. market for 2023, _Kelley Blue Book_, a _Cox Automotive_ company, on Dec. 15 announced the winners of its annual Best Buy Awards.
Now in its ninth year, the company's comprehensive awards program highlights the top model in vehicle segments most relevant to new-car shoppers, with award categories evolving over the years to align with the changing automotive landscape.

## Key takeaways
The 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Awards encompass 19 categories covering the entire spectrum of automotive needs, with additional categories introduced this year to reflect the ever-growing electrified-vehicle segments.
This year's highest honor of Best New Model goes to the 2023 _Hyundai_ IONIQ 5.
"The number of electric vehicles available to new-car shoppers continues to increase at a staggering pace, and the competition continues to get hotter as these efficient rides gain popularity among consumers," said **Jason Allan**, principal editor of reviews and ratings for Kelley Blue Book. "Our team was so impressed with the all-new Hyundai IONIQ 5 during this year's Best Buy Awards testing that we didn't just give it the title of Best Electric Vehicle for 2023, it also earned our Best New Model trophy.
"It is truly a vehicle that exemplifies how easy it can be now to go all-electric, boasting the kind of impressive range and tech features that consumers have come to expect, and offering terrific value relative to the competition," Allan said. "In addition to the Best New Model, our team also named the top 2023 model-year vehicles in the categories most relevant to today's car shoppers."
This year, Kelley Blue Book partnered with NASCAR driver **Toni Breidinger** so she could use her professional racecar driver skills to put the top winner to the test out on the "track" of real-world driving. Breidinger joined Kelley Blue Book's editors for a day of test driving the Hyundai IONIQ 5, sharing her thoughts and driving impressions as she evaluated the all-new model through the lens of a racecar driver.
"As a lifelong automotive enthusiast, it was a thrill to join the experts from Kelley Blue Book for a day to put the 2023 Hyundai IONIQ 5 to the test," said Breidinger. "The spacious interior and extended dashboard really stood out to me. Most importantly, I appreciated the all-electric range. After a test day with the IONIQ 5, I can confirm this year's Best New Model is racer-approved."

## Key takeaways
Kelley Blue Book's annual Best Buy Awards are determined based on a year-long regimen of expert vehicle evaluation, plus an intensive period of final testing. The reviews, ratings and awards are driven by analysis of a broad array of vehicle-related data, including vehicle pricing, 5-Year Cost to Own data---which includes depreciation, insurance, maintenance, financing, fuel, fees and taxes for new cars---along with consumer reviews and ratings and vehicle sales information.
To be considered for Kelley Blue Book's highest accolade, Best New Model, the vehicle must be an all-new or redesigned vehicle---unavailable before the prior year's final Best Buy Awards testing---and offer a strong value proposition to consumers based on pricing, innovation and available standard technology and safety features.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best Electric Vehicle and Best New Model: 2023 Hyundai IONIQ 5
With more than 300 miles of range, a spacious, tech-filled interior and an impressive starting price, the Hyundai IONIQ 5 shows how easy it can be for someone to go all electric. You can even go from 10% charge to 80% in as little as 18 minutes.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best Compact Car: 2023 Honda Civic
There's a reason the 2023 _Honda_ Civic tops the Best Compact Car list, a feat it has now accomplished eight of the last nine years: It just does everything right. The Civic sedan is a joy to drive. It's a worry-free mode of transport that won't break the budget, and the Civic holds its value exceptionally well.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best Subcompact SUV: 2023 Kia Seltos
When shopping for a subcompact SUV, every dollar counts. That's why the _Kia_ Seltos is the Best Subcompact SUV winner again for 2023. Its low starting price, long list of standard tech and safety features, impressive fuel economy and fantastic warranty make the Seltos a terrific value. This stylish SUV also boasts one of the roomiest interiors in its class.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best Compact SUV: 2023 Honda CR-V
The Honda CR-V has been among the easiest vehicles to recommend for many, many years. In fact, it has been named a Kelley Blue Book Best Buy more times than any other compact SUV. Fresh off a complete redesign and now bigger and better than ever, the CR-V has reclaimed its place as the compact SUV deemed to be the best choice for the most people.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best 2-Row Midsize SUV: 2023 Hyundai Santa Fe
Kelley Blue Book recognizes not only the immense value of this five-passenger SUV but also its wide appeal. Hyundai hangs its collective hat on its value story, and nowhere is that value more apparent than in the level and quality of its technology. To find an SUV at this price point with this degree of attention to detail inside and out is a tribute to Hyundai's genius for making every dollar count.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best 3-Row Midsize SUV: 2023 Kia Telluride
For 2023, the Telluride wins this category for the fourth time, winning every year since it went on sale. The Telluride is great-looking and roomy with an upscale interior. It's practical with a stacked roster of standard safety and convenience equipment. The Telluride is an excellent value in the midsize SUV segment.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best Full-Size SUV: 2023 Ford Expedition
The 2023 _Ford_ Expedition is a comfortable, refined eight-passenger full-size SUV that is ready for work and travel. It can tow up to 9,300 pounds, while features like Pro Trailer Backup Assist 2.0 and a blind-spot system that also accounts for the trailer make towing easier.

## 2023 Kelley Blue Book Best Buy Award Winners
### Best Compact Pickup Truck: 2023 Ford Maverick
The Ford Maverick heralds the return of the compact pickup, providing light-duty versatility in a truck as easy on gas as it is on the eyes. With nearly 500 miles of range, the hybrid Maverick bests even the most frugal subcompact, yet it's capable of hauling a 1,500-pound payload and towing up to 2,000 pounds---or 4,000 pounds with the all-gas powertrain.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## Kelley Blue Book’s ‘Best Compact SUVs of 2023’
Each year, Kelley Blue Book editors examine each entry in the compact SUV segment. They look at every model’s exterior design, interior styling, performance, reliability, safety features, and overall value.In addition, they take into account reviews from other industry experts and consumers. But most important, the editors test-drive and live with every vehicle for “performance, features, cargo space, technology, build, fuel economy, and more.”
KBB’s yearly list of the best compact SUVs includes models from various automakers, including mainstream brands like Ford, Honda, and Toyota. It might also contain SUVs from luxury brands like Audi, BMW, and Mercedes-Benz. Each vehicle on the list gets a thorough overview, including key features, price ranges, and specifications, to help consumers make informed decisions.
And this year, the only luxury SUV to make the list is the 2023 Audi Q5, ranking third out of 11 vehicles. Topping the rankings in first and second place are the 2023 Honda CR-V and CR-V Hybrid. The 2023 Kia Sportage takes fourth, fifth, and seventh place with the standard model, Sportage Hybrid, and Sportage Plug-In Hybrid. The 2023 Toyota RAV4 sits in sixth, seventh, and ninth with the standard model, RAV4 Hybrid, and RAV4 Prime plug-in hybrid. And rounding out the list in 10th and 11th place are two Mazda compact SUVs: the CX-5 and the CX-50.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## The 2023 Audi Q5 is the only luxury SUV in KBB’s ‘Best Compact SUVs’ this year
2023 Audi Q5 Prestige | Audi AG
The 2023 Audi Q5 compact luxury SUV seats five and is available in three trim levels, each offering various configurations. All have a seven-speed automatic transmission. The standard engine is a 201-hp 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder. Quicker acceleration is available with a more powerful 261-hp four-cylinder or a 362-hp plug-in hybrid. When properly equipped, the Q5 has a maximum towing capacity of 4,400 pounds.
The new Audi Q5 is loaded with infotainment features, such as Bang & Olufsen premium speakers, Android Auto, and wireless Apple CarPlay. It has all the convenience and comfort features you’d expect from a luxury SUV and includes a full slate of advanced safety features. It offers a blind-spot and lane departure warnings accident avoidance system, lane-keep assist, rear cross-traffic alert, adaptive cruise control, and more.
2023 Audi Q5 prices range from about $44,200 to $67,00, according to Audi.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## Kelley Blue Book’s verdict
2023 Audi Q5 interior | Audi AG
KBB editors loved the 2023 Audi Q5’sVirtual Cockpit Plus, a standard digital gauge cluster on the Premium Plus and Prestige trims. The customizable display can show entertainment info, navigation intel, road signs, and more. They also liked the user-friendliness of its high-tech standard infotainment system, with a stunning 10.1-inch display and many popular features, including HD Radio and a Wi-Fi hotspot.
KBB also appreciated the diverse selection of engines in the new Audi Q5. They liked that the Quattro all-wheel drive system is standard on every model. It improves traction in any weather condition for a more confident, powerful drive.

Title: These Are the Compact SUVs With the Most Cargo Space

These SUVs may be small overall, but they're spacious where it matters.
Like Mary Poppins' bag, some small SUVs hold more inside than one would reasonably expect based on their exterior proportions. The efficient use of space almost feels like magic.
Space-saving designs are particularly important for compact SUVs, which are wildly popular among Americans. Many drivers want an SUV small and light enough to maneuver crowded streets and sip fuel but large enough inside to comfortably carry their passengers and haul whatever items they happen to have. This list focuses on the latter desire.

## Our Top Picks Among Compact SUVs With the Most Cargo Space
*   **Compact SUV With the Most Cargo Space:****2026 Kia Sportage****—** As far as compact SUVs go, the Kia Sportage holds it own against fellow heavyweights like the Honda CR-V and Hyundai Tucson ... READ MORE »

*   **Best Gas Mileage:****2026 Nissan Rogue****—** The Nissan Rogue has all the makings of a family SUV. Aside from having a ton of storage room, it returns wonderful fuel economy of 29 mpg ... READ MORE »
These are the compact SUVs with the largest cargo holds. We rank the models based on those with the most space behind their second-row seats and working downward, though we also include our top picks at the top of the list. Ties are broken based on which model has the most amount of cargo space behind its first-row seats.
As you read, keep in mind that we update our reviews as more data becomes available, so the numbers you see here might not match an SUV's individual review. Be sure to check each model's review page for the most current information.

As far as compact SUVs go, the Kia Sportage holds its own against fellow heavyweights like the Honda CR-V and Hyundai Tucson. Major styling upgrades and new features for 2026 make this Kia one of the best compact SUVs you can buy, especially if you're looking for massive cargo dimensions. With a base price under $29,000, it's also the most affordable choice on this list.

## Our Top Picks Among Compact SUVs With the Most Cargo Space
U.S. News Autos Managing Editor Alex Kwanten says this Kia has "plenty of cubbies and bins, including a big area in the console." He also says the cup holders in the console can adjust to fit different-sized bottles or coffee cups, which is convenient. Cloth seats are roomy and plush in the first row, and the second row is big enough for two adults to sit comfortably. A 12.3-inch touch screen comes standard, along with voice recognition and wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto.
The driving experience can be underwhelming, and the SUV's 2.5-liter four-cylinder base engine feels underpowered. Still, the Sportage is affordably priced and exceptionally safe, so it may be worth it to overlook those pitfalls.

A friend once asked me which vehicle I would blanket recommend to the most amount of shoppers without knowing their needs. I didn't hesitate before saying the Hyundai Tucson. Obviously, it isn't right for everyone, but I think it's a good choice for a large share of people because it exceeds at the essentials. It's stylish, affordable, reliable and safe, plus it has one of the largest cargo holds in the class.
Beyond stellar cargo space, the Tuscon provides a host of benefits to buyers. Its cabin is handsome and tech-forward, and the standard cloth seats are spacious, no matter where you sit. A 12.3-inch touch screen heads the infotainment system, and features like Baby Mode, push-button start and driver-attention monitoring come standard. It also won our Best Compact SUV for the Money award this year.

## Our Top Picks Among Compact SUVs With the Most Cargo Space
If you're looking for a thrilling ride, look elsewhere, because the Tucson doesn't pack much punch. Its standard 2.5-liter four-cylinder engine won't zip you around, but it does make for nice city driving and highway merging. Its eight-speed automatic transmission could use some retuning, but the ride quality overall is a delight.

In reviewing the Rogue, our test driver says this SUV "checks most of the boxes buyers in this family-oriented class expect today." It has high safety and reliability scores, and it's packed with standard features like an 8-inch touch screen with wired Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, pedestrian detection and blind-spot monitoring. The base Rogue has cloth seating, though synthetic or genuine leather is available in higher trims.
The only drawbacks to the Rogue are its boring driving dynamics and sluggish powertrain, but those may be deciding factors for some shoppers.

The refreshed CR-V retains its massive cargo hold from previous models, and though the interior design can be a bit drab, the standard cloth seats are large and well-cushioned in both rows. However, though Honda equips the CR-V with a larger standard touch screen, the software it runs is still pretty basic.
Managing Editor Alex Kwanten says he recommends the CR-V as a commuter vehicle because "it’s quiet, calm and reassuring – more Clark Kent than Superman." Off-the-line acceleration is fairly relaxed, courtesy of the CR-V's 1.5-liter turbo-four engine, and handling is balanced. The CR-V has a high starting price relative to its classmates, though.

The base engine, though somewhat anemic, is efficient, returning 27/34 mpg city/highway with front-wheel drive. And if the Escape's low-rent cabin materials don't wow you, at least you'll have enough room to stretch out in either row.

## Our Top Picks Among Compact SUVs With the Most Cargo Space
An 8-inch touch screen comes standard, as does wireless smartphone connectivity and a Wi-Fi hotspot. There are also a bunch of standard safety features on the Escape, including forward and reverse automatic emergency braking, lane-keep assist and blind-spot monitoring. One important note: If you want this Ford, you'll have to act fast, because the automaker is discontinuing it after the 2026 model year.

The Land Rover Discover Sport proves luxury vehicles can have practical applications, at least when it comes to the amount of things you can fit in its cargo hold. There's also plenty of space for passengers, though the available third row is tiny and seriously cuts into the available storage space. Our reviewer says the 6.9 cubic feet of cargo space with the third row in use is "barely enough for a couple of bags of groceries."
This stylish Land Rover boasts true off-road abilities, however, with standard all-wheel drive, variable terrain modes and nearly two feet of water fording depth. No matter what terrain you choose to traverse, the Discovery Sport will keep you comfortable. It may not be the most exciting to drive thanks to an underpowered turbo-four engine, but its standard leather seats have plenty of bolstering to make you feel supported, and amenities like a heated steering wheel ensure the driver gets extra special treatment.
For all its strengths, it's worth noting the Discovery Sport finishes near the bottom of our rankings for its class.

There are certainly more affordable ways to get a compact SUV with a lot of cargo space, but if you prize luxury and comfort over bargains, the BMW X3 will be a fine companion. It's also fun to drive, with spry handling and a pair of powerful engine options. Perhaps the best part? Its exciting driving dynamics don't diminish its good fuel economy estimates.
The X3's seats are spacious and well-cushioned, though this SUV's interior materials aren't up to snuff. "The thinly padded door panels and dashboard aren't as nice as what you’ll find in rivals, and some sharp plastic edges on the door armrests are a departure from BMW's reputation for cabin build quality," says our reviewer.
This BMW comes standard with a 14.9-inch touch screen, wireless smartphone connectivity, forward collision warning with forward automatic emergency braking and driver-attention monitoring. Unfortunately, the infotainment software has a pretty steep learning curve on account of its complicated menu structure.
8) 2025 Infiniti QX50
8.1/10 U.S. News Score

*   $43,000
The Infiniti QX50 is focused on comfort over performance, and even then, it doesn't exactly deliver. Ride quality is mostly comfortable, unless you're driving over particularly bumpy pavement. This SUV also has attractive interior styling and, as a requisite to being on this list, commendable cargo capacity.
The QX50 misses a mark in a lot of areas, though. Its turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine should theoretically deliver exciting acceleration, but its continuously variable automatic transmission holds it back. The setup is also noticeably noisy under fairly reasonable strain.

## Our Top Picks Among Compact SUVs With the Most Cargo Space
Another drawback is its aging infotainment system. Reviewer Jasmine Sayles says "even though the infotainment interface didn’t completely let me down, the pros I did find don't make up for the cons, like low-res rearview camera graphics or the small upper touch screen." On the bright side, features like wireless Apple CarPlay, wireless device charging, pedestrian detection and lane-keep assist come standard.

*   Cargo and Storage Score: 6.9/10  
*   U.S. News Rating: 8.8/10  
*   $29,900
Mazda has built a strong reputation for providing near-luxury interiors in vehicles with mainstream price tags, and the 2026 CX-50 fits that mold perfectly. It might not have the largest cargo hold in its class, but it's still pretty big by compact SUV standards, and the rest of the interior is downright premium.
The seats are comfortable and cushy, and myriad adjustment options increase the likelihood you'll find a comfortable seating position. The design is fairly minimalist but not boring, and a 10.25-inch infotainment screen adds some pizzazz to the dashboard. Unfortunately, that screen is controlled by a rotary knob in the center console unless you're using Apple CarPlay or Android Auto, which can get annoying.
No matter which of this Mazda's two engine options you choose, you're sure to have a good time. Both are punchy and pair well with the deft handling dynamics. Zach Doell, our vehicle testing editor, says the "steering feels snappy and sufficiently weighted, and the brakes bring the SUV to a quick, smooth stop."

*   U.S. News Rating: 8.2/10  
*   $29,995
The Mitsubishi Outlander received a refresh in 2025 that gave it new interior materials and an updated infotainment system. The changes are welcome, but they still don't do enough to put this compact SUV in contention with models at the top of the class.
Unlike most vehicles on this list, the Outlander comes with a third row. But like most third rows in compact SUVs, it's cramped and drastically reduces rear cargo capacity. Fortunately, John Vincent, U.S. News' senior editor for vehicle testing, notes the first two rows are spacious and plush for adults. Cargo capacity behind the first and second rows is also a bright spot on this SUV's resume.
Ride quality is composed, and the Outlander's 2.5-liter four-cylinder powerplant, while underpowered at highway speeds, generates enough oomph to perform readily around town. A 12.3-inch touch screen with wireless smartphone connectivity heads the infotainment system, which is easy to use. However, some reviewers note it still looks a bit dated.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## Kelley Blue Book’s ‘Best Compact SUVs of 2023’
Each year, Kelley Blue Book editors examine each entry in the compact SUV segment. They look at every model’s exterior design, interior styling, performance, reliability, safety features, and overall value.In addition, they take into account reviews from other industry experts and consumers. But most important, the editors test-drive and live with every vehicle for “performance, features, cargo space, technology, build, fuel economy, and more.”
KBB’s yearly list of the best compact SUVs includes models from various automakers, including mainstream brands like Ford, Honda, and Toyota. It might also contain SUVs from luxury brands like Audi, BMW, and Mercedes-Benz. Each vehicle on the list gets a thorough overview, including key features, price ranges, and specifications, to help consumers make informed decisions.
And this year, the only luxury SUV to make the list is the 2023 Audi Q5, ranking third out of 11 vehicles. Topping the rankings in first and second place are the 2023 Honda CR-V and CR-V Hybrid. The 2023 Kia Sportage takes fourth, fifth, and seventh place with the standard model, Sportage Hybrid, and Sportage Plug-In Hybrid. The 2023 Toyota RAV4 sits in sixth, seventh, and ninth with the standard model, RAV4 Hybrid, and RAV4 Prime plug-in hybrid. And rounding out the list in 10th and 11th place are two Mazda compact SUVs: the CX-5 and the CX-50.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## The 2023 Audi Q5 is the only luxury SUV in KBB’s ‘Best Compact SUVs’ this year
2023 Audi Q5 Prestige | Audi AG
The 2023 Audi Q5 compact luxury SUV seats five and is available in three trim levels, each offering various configurations. All have a seven-speed automatic transmission. The standard engine is a 201-hp 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder. Quicker acceleration is available with a more powerful 261-hp four-cylinder or a 362-hp plug-in hybrid. When properly equipped, the Q5 has a maximum towing capacity of 4,400 pounds.
The new Audi Q5 is loaded with infotainment features, such as Bang & Olufsen premium speakers, Android Auto, and wireless Apple CarPlay. It has all the convenience and comfort features you’d expect from a luxury SUV and includes a full slate of advanced safety features. It offers a blind-spot and lane departure warnings accident avoidance system, lane-keep assist, rear cross-traffic alert, adaptive cruise control, and more.
2023 Audi Q5 prices range from about $44,200 to $67,00, according to Audi.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## Kelley Blue Book’s verdict
2023 Audi Q5 interior | Audi AG
KBB editors loved the 2023 Audi Q5’sVirtual Cockpit Plus, a standard digital gauge cluster on the Premium Plus and Prestige trims. The customizable display can show entertainment info, navigation intel, road signs, and more. They also liked the user-friendliness of its high-tech standard infotainment system, with a stunning 10.1-inch display and many popular features, including HD Radio and a Wi-Fi hotspot.
KBB also appreciated the diverse selection of engines in the new Audi Q5. They liked that the Quattro all-wheel drive system is standard on every model. It improves traction in any weather condition for a more confident, powerful drive.
In addition to the standard Q5 SUV body style, buyers can opt for the Sportback, which KBB found to be stylish with the aesthetic of an “SUV coupe.” While there’s more cargo space in the standard body, the Sportback is an attention-getter with great visual appeal. Still, KBB believes the 2023 Audi Q5 in either body style would benefit from additional cargo space.
The high-performance model SQ5, with its turbocharged V6, offers a thrilling driving experience. It also features upgraded brakes with adaptive damping suspension. It’s expensive, so if you likehowy it looks, you might also consider the S Line model, according to KBB.
The only other criticism Kelley Blue Book editors had was that some of the 2023 Audi Q5’s peers are more affordable.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## Kelley Blue Book’s ‘Best Compact SUVs of 2023’
Each year, Kelley Blue Book editors examine each entry in the compact SUV segment. They look at every model’s exterior design, interior styling, performance, reliability, safety features, and overall value.In addition, they take into account reviews from other industry experts and consumers. But most important, the editors test-drive and live with every vehicle for “performance, features, cargo space, technology, build, fuel economy, and more.”
KBB’s yearly list of the best compact SUVs includes models from various automakers, including mainstream brands like Ford, Honda, and Toyota. It might also contain SUVs from luxury brands like Audi, BMW, and Mercedes-Benz. Each vehicle on the list gets a thorough overview, including key features, price ranges, and specifications, to help consumers make informed decisions.
And this year, the only luxury SUV to make the list is the 2023 Audi Q5, ranking third out of 11 vehicles. Topping the rankings in first and second place are the 2023 Honda CR-V and CR-V Hybrid. The 2023 Kia Sportage takes fourth, fifth, and seventh place with the standard model, Sportage Hybrid, and Sportage Plug-In Hybrid. The 2023 Toyota RAV4 sits in sixth, seventh, and ninth with the standard model, RAV4 Hybrid, and RAV4 Prime plug-in hybrid. And rounding out the list in 10th and 11th place are two Mazda compact SUVs: the CX-5 and the CX-50.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## The 2023 Audi Q5 is the only luxury SUV in KBB’s ‘Best Compact SUVs’ this year
2023 Audi Q5 Prestige | Audi AG
The 2023 Audi Q5 compact luxury SUV seats five and is available in three trim levels, each offering various configurations. All have a seven-speed automatic transmission. The standard engine is a 201-hp 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder. Quicker acceleration is available with a more powerful 261-hp four-cylinder or a 362-hp plug-in hybrid. When properly equipped, the Q5 has a maximum towing capacity of 4,400 pounds.
The new Audi Q5 is loaded with infotainment features, such as Bang & Olufsen premium speakers, Android Auto, and wireless Apple CarPlay. It has all the convenience and comfort features you’d expect from a luxury SUV and includes a full slate of advanced safety features. It offers a blind-spot and lane departure warnings accident avoidance system, lane-keep assist, rear cross-traffic alert, adaptive cruise control, and more.
2023 Audi Q5 prices range from about $44,200 to $67,00, according to Audi.

# Only 1 Luxury SUV Cracks Kelley Blue Book’s Best Compact SUVs of 2023
## Kelley Blue Book’s verdict
2023 Audi Q5 interior | Audi AG
KBB editors loved the 2023 Audi Q5’sVirtual Cockpit Plus, a standard digital gauge cluster on the Premium Plus and Prestige trims. The customizable display can show entertainment info, navigation intel, road signs, and more. They also liked the user-friendliness of its high-tech standard infotainment system, with a stunning 10.1-inch display and many popular features, including HD Radio and a Wi-Fi hotspot.
KBB also appreciated the diverse selection of engines in the new Audi Q5. They liked that the Quattro all-wheel drive system is standard on every model. It improves traction in any weather condition for a more confident, powerful drive.
In addition to the standard Q5 SUV body style, buyers can opt for the Sportback, which KBB found to be stylish with the aesthetic of an “SUV coupe.” While there’s more cargo space in the standard body, the Sportback is an attention-getter with great visual appeal. Still, KBB believes the 2023 Audi Q5 in either body style would benefit from additional cargo space.
The high-performance model SQ5, with its turbocharged V6, offers a thrilling driving experience. It also features upgraded brakes with adaptive damping suspension. It’s expensive, so if you likehowy it looks, you might also consider the S Line model, according to KBB.
The only other criticism Kelley Blue Book editors had was that some of the 2023 Audi Q5’s peers are more affordable.

Searching for a ride that offers great space? Still need your daily driver to provide an efficient commute? Well, you may want to turn your attention to the Kia Sportage. The Sportage is a sizable and sporty Kia SUV, which comes ready to provide an all-around driving experience with its comfortable cabin and proficient powertrain.
In this Kia Sportage MPG review, our team here at Feldman Kia will dive into the model’s fuel efficiency figures and how it is able to earn them. That way, you can get a better feel as to whether or not it could be a fit for you around Novi, Livonia, and Southfield, MI.

## **Kia Sportage Engineering**
* * *
Before we get into the weeds with the Sportage’s MPG figures, we thought it would first be important to cover the engineering under the hood. So, that is where we’ll start.
When you pop the hood on the Sportage, you will find a **2.5L 4-cylinder engine** at work. This engine will arm you with **187 horsepower** as well as **178 lb-ft of torque**. Plus, this engine also comes mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. You can expect an efficient ride thanks to this setup.

## **Diving into Fuel Economy**
* * *
So, what are the exact MPG figures that the Kia Sportage is able to earn? Well, you will be delighted to know that the Kia SUV comes ready to earn an EPA-estimated 25 city and 32 highway MPG.1 So, whether you are traversing the open road or navigating tight downtown corners, you can count on a fuel-efficient ride.

## **Available Hybrid and Plug-In Hybrid Powertrains**
* * *
Now, in addition to a traditional gas-powered powertrain, the Sportage also offers Hybrid and Plug-In Hybrid setups. These, of course, will alter the fuel economy figures that you are able to earn behind the wheel.
*   **_Sportage Hybrid:_**Looking at the Kia Sportage Hybrid, you will find an engine that comes ready to arm you with 227 horsepower and 258 lb-ft of torque. Perhaps more impressively, though, is this Kia’s ability to earn an EPA-estimated 42 city and 44 highway MPG.2  
*   **_Sportage Plug-In Hybrid:_**The Kia Sportage Plug-In Hybrid, of course, is also quite efficient. With it fully charged, it will offer you an EPA-estimated 84 combined MPGe (miles per gallon of gasoline-equivalent).3

## **Other Ways to Improve MPG**
* * *
No matter which powertrain you pick, you can count on an efficient ride behind the wheel of your Kia Sportage. There are some ways you can help it further prioritize fuel economy, too.
For example, the Kia boasts a 39.6-cubic foot cargo area. This will prove helpful for storing a number of different items. When you no longer need an item in the Kia SUV, though, it is best to take it out. This is because added weight can make the engine work harder, burn more fuel, and decrease MPG.
So, removing unnecessary weight can be a great way to ensure you max out your fuel economy figures.

## **Learn More About the Kia Sportage and its MPG**
* * *
Impressed with the Kia Sportage thus far? Get in touch with our team here at Feldman Kia, and we’ll be happy to help you learn more.
We’re proud to serve Novi, Livonia, and Southfield, Michigan, area drivers and hope to assist you soon!
